svg.title: Spectrum Colors Arranged by Chance
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Observed 38×38 source grid sampled at cell centres; colours assigned to a interpretive family palette. No chance pattern generated. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of orange, pink, red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/work/spectrum-colors-arranged-by-chance/; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
